## Purpose

Standalone walkthrough of `_targets.R`'s `tdr_clean_combined` ->
`tdr_analysis_ready` steps, calling
`2_preprocessing/R/functions_tdr.R` directly.

```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

source(here("2_preprocessing", "R", "functions_tdr.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "utils.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "plot_theme.R"))
```

## Step 1: Combine the manually-reviewed clean TDR files

Each file is one sampling round's readings (one row per probe); there is no
raw/preprocessing stage bundled in this repo -- see the docstring on
`preprocess_TDR_data()` in `functions_tdr.R` for why (only the later,
reviewed `CLEAN_TDR_DATA` stage is bundled under `1_input_data/tdr_data/`).

```{r combine}
tdr_clean_combined <- combine_clean_tdr_data(here("1_input_data", "tdr_data"))
tdr_clean_combined |> glimpse()
```

## Step 2: Derive location/treatment covariates

`derive_tdr_covariates()` attaches `LOCATION` (BETWEEN_PV/OUTSIDE_PV, from
which sub-strip the probe is in) and `TREATMENT` (fertilisation, from a
hardcoded field-layout lookup -- TDR nests were not laid out on the same
grid as the yield trial, so this cannot be derived the same way
`add_study2_covariates()` does it). `RESIDUE` is not available at the
TDR-nest level.

```{r covariates}
tdr_analysis_ready <- derive_tdr_covariates(tdr_clean_combined)
tdr_analysis_ready |> glimpse()
```

```{r coverage-check}
tdr_analysis_ready |> count(LOCATION, TREATMENT, CROP)
```

## Step 3: Time series preview (EDA)

```{r ts-preview}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
plot_tdr_time_series(tdr_analysis_ready)
```
